"""按消息传递说话人姓名，不连接 ASR、LLM、TTS 或音频设备。"""

import asyncio
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from aichat_sdk import ChatBot
from aichat_sdk.llm import LlmAgent
from aichat_sdk.llm.type_enum import AgentInfo, DeviceInfo
from aichat_sdk.utils.event_emitter import AsyncEventEmitter


class SpeakerNameTest(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def asyncSetUp(self):
        async def chat_stream(*args, **kwargs):
            yield "text", "好的"

        with patch("aichat_sdk.llm.SystemPrompt") as prompt, \
                patch("aichat_sdk.llm.OpenAIClient", return_value=SimpleNamespace(chat_stream=chat_stream)):
            prompt.return_value.render.return_value = "你是语音助手"
            self.llm = LlmAgent(DeviceInfo(timezone=8), AgentInfo())

    def user_payloads(self):
        return [json.loads(message["content"]) for message in self.llm.messages if message["role"] == "user"]

    async def test_explicit_names_are_per_message_and_audio_url_is_preserved(self):
        await self.llm.chat("开灯", "user", audio_url="/audio/one.wav", speaker=" 小明 ")
        await self.llm.chat("关灯", "user", speaker="小红")
        await self.llm.chat("未知说话人", "user", speaker="")
        await self.llm.chat("打字", "user")
        payloads = self.user_payloads()
        self.assertEqual([payload.get("speaker") for payload in payloads], ["小明", "小红", None, None])
        self.assertEqual(self.llm.messages[1]["audio_url"], "/audio/one.wav")
        self.assertEqual([payload["round"] for payload in payloads], [1, 2, 3, 4])

    async def test_removed_name_keyword_is_not_accepted(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            await self.llm.chat("开灯", "user", username="小明")
        bot = self.make_bot()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            await bot.send_text("开灯", username="小明")

    async def test_optional_speaker_is_not_carried_to_the_next_message(self):
        await self.llm.chat("匿名说话人", "user", speaker="speaker_1")
        await self.llm.chat("未提供说话人", "user", speaker=None)
        await self.llm.chat("空白说话人", "user", speaker=" ")
        payloads = self.user_payloads()
        self.assertEqual([p.get("speaker") for p in payloads], ["speaker_1", None, None])
        self.assertEqual(set(payloads[0]), {"text", "time", "round", "speaker"})
        self.assertEqual(set(payloads[1]), {"text", "time", "round"})

    async def test_invalid_name_rejected_before_appending_message(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "speaker"):
            await self.llm.chat("开灯", "user", speaker={"name": "小明"})
        self.assertEqual(self.user_payloads(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.llm.round, 0)

    async def test_tool_limit_followup_keeps_the_same_speaker(self):
        calls = 0

        async def chat_stream(*args, **kwargs):
            nonlocal calls
            calls += 1
            if calls <= 5:
                yield "tool", {"id": "call", "name": "example", "arguments": "{}"}
            else:
                yield "text", "完成"

        self.llm.llm_client.chat_stream = chat_stream
        self.llm._build_tool_messages = AsyncMock(return_value=[
            {"role": "assistant", "content": None}, {"role": "tool", "content": "结果"},
        ])
        await self.llm.chat("查一下", "user", speaker="小明")
        self.assertEqual([p.get("speaker") for p in self.user_payloads()], ["小明", "小明"])

    def make_bot(self):
        with patch("aichat_sdk.LlmAgent", return_value=self.llm), \
                patch("aichat_sdk.get_tts_client", return_value=SimpleNamespace(
                    abort=AsyncMock(), close=AsyncMock(), set_last_context_text=Mock(),
                )), patch("aichat_sdk.OpusStreamEncoder"):
            bot = ChatBot()
        self.addAsyncCleanup(bot.close)
        return bot

    async def test_chatbot_send_text_forwards_name(self):
        bot = self.make_bot()
        await bot.send_text("开灯", audio_url="/audio/one.wav", speaker="小明")
        await bot.send_text("打字")
        self.assertEqual([p.get("speaker") for p in self.user_payloads()], ["小明", None])
        self.assertEqual(self.llm.messages[1]["audio_url"], "/audio/one.wav")

    async def test_asr_dispatch_forwards_optional_speaker(self):
        bot = self.make_bot()
        await bot.reg_asr()
        for payload in ({"content": "开灯", "speaker": "speaker_1", "audio_url": "/audio/one.wav"},
